scope: Read-only source and published-summary audit. No new native simulation, waveform fit, gate override, clock-tree qualification or full-PHY acceptance.

column_binding.consumer_requirement: Resolve every saved_vector against exact pinned observed-column-contract.json and actual5106-column header; reject missing, duplicate or non-voltage columns before observing samples.

expected_nominal_cycle_ratios.scope: Diagnostic only; account fixed propagation delays and open-window endpoints without shifting/resampling waveforms or changing acceptance.

interpretation_limits: Locate first missing full-amplitude stage cycle; separately count zero-crossing multiplicity, pulse width, swing and common mode. Average frequency alone is insufficient.
No edge removal, adaptive thresholds, phase fitting, resampling, ideal internal clock injection or acceptance override.
Publicclkp/clkn enable actual PLL output swing/common-mode observation, not complete serialPHY or startup-deterministic TX phase-tree qualification.

legacy_tuning_context.scope: LegacyC8/oldRC external idealVTUNE clamp diagnostic only, not currentRHI120 tuning curve, repair or acquisition proof.
